queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), its official service-centre directory, the official PLRA site, and the PLRA-hosted GIS/tile configuration in the current JavaScript bundle. PLRA officially lists an Arazi Record Centre for Tehsil Mian Channu. No anonymous public parcel feature service or safe ID-plus-geometry response was found.

service.name: PLRA public site and PLRA/PULSE map tile configuration
service.viewerConfiguration: The current PLRA JavaScript bundle references gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis and a district-keyed raster tile template at dmaps.pulse.gop.pk/{sheet}/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Khanewal is configured as sheet 13D. The bounded tile at z=16/x=45939/y=26945 returned PNG raster imagery for the exact WUP-point tile; it contained no queryable parcel identity or vector geometry.
